```{r setup, include=FALSE}

rm(list=ls())
gc()

load.lib <- c("tidyverse", "data.table", "sf", "here", "units")

install.lib <- load.lib[!load.lib %in% installed.packages()]

for(lib in install.lib) install.packages(lib,dependencies=TRUE)
sapply(load.lib,require,character=TRUE)

# Turn off s2 and use
# geos since you are computing
# distance
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

dir <- here(getwd())

survey.path <- "ATM CPS Survey"

source("functions.R")

# Since the data falls within two UTM zones and there is not an ideal projection
# to use, apply a custom equal area albers projection
aea_custom <- "+proj=aea +lat_1=30 +lat_2=50 +lat_0=40 +lon_0=-124.5 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"

```

# Load the cleaned data

```{r, load.clean.us.data}

US.specimen.dat.clean <- fread(
  here(dir, "Data", survey.path,
            "2003.2024.ATM.Survey.with.specimen.data.csv"), 
       sep = ",")

dim(US.specimen.dat.clean)
# [1] 21105  26

# Only keep summer data for this check
test <- US.specimen.dat.clean |> 
  filter(cruise > 200804 & cruise < 202103)
unique(test$cruise)
#  [1] 200807 200904 201004 201104 201204 201207 201304 201307 201404 201407
# [11] 201504 201507 201604 201607 201704 201707 201807 201907 201208

test2 <- test |> 
  filter(grepl("07$|08$", as.character(cruise))) |>
  mutate(cruise = as.numeric(cruise))

length(unique(test2$keys))
# [1] 2236

```

# Load unmatched data 

```{r, unmatched.us.data}

#-------------------------------------
# Load data without specimen data
#-------------------------------------
no.specimen.dat <- fread(
  here(dir, "Data", survey.path,
       "ATM.Survey.no.corresponding.specimen.table.entry.csv"),
       sep = ",")

dim(no.specimen.dat)
# [1] 11  20

# Identify columns not in specimen.dat
!colnames(US.specimen.dat.clean) %in%
  colnames(no.specimen.dat)
#  [1] FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE
# [12] FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE  TRUE  TRUE  TRUE
# [23]  TRUE  TRUE  TRUE  TRUE

# Retrieve names 
names(US.specimen.dat.clean)[c(20:26)]
# [1] "latitude"         "longitude"        "specimen_number" 
# [4] "is_random_sample" "weight"           "standard_length" 
# [7] "Species_weight"  

# Add placeholder values
no.specimen.dat <- no.specimen.dat |>
  mutate(latitude = NA,
         longitude = NA,
         specimen_number = NA,
         is_random_sample = NA,
         weight = NA,
         standard_length = NA,
         Species_weight = 
           subsample_weight+remaining_weight)

#-------------------------------------
# Load data without individual lengths
#-------------------------------------
Haul.weights.sar.no.length <- fread(
  here(dir, "Data", survey.path,
       "ATM.Survey.no.length.table.entry.csv"),
       sep = ",") 

dim(Haul.weights.sar.no.length)
# [1]  8 28

# Add like column
Haul.weights.sar.no.length <- 
  Haul.weights.sar.no.length |>
  mutate(Species_weight = subsample_weight+remaining_weight)

```

# Join unmatched data

These will be the hauls to to fill in.

```{r, join.unmatched.data}

# Check columns
!colnames(Haul.weights.sar.no.length) %in%
  colnames(no.specimen.dat)
#  [1] FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE
# [12] FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE
# [23] FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE  TRUE  TRUE

# Identify missing columns
names(Haul.weights.sar.no.length)[27:28]
# [1] "quality.indic" "FID"

# Remove unnecessary columns
Haul.weights.sar.no.length <- 
  Haul.weights.sar.no.length |>
  select(-c(quality.indic, FID)) 

# Find if there are any columns in no.specimen.dat we need to check
!colnames(no.specimen.dat) %in% colnames(Haul.weights.sar.no.length)
#  [1] FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE
# [12] FALSE FALSE  TRUE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE
# [23] FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE

names(no.specimen.dat)[14]
# [1] "keys.temp"

# Add missing column
Haul.weights.sar.no.length <- Haul.weights.sar.no.length |>
  mutate(keys.temp = paste(cruise, ship, haul, collection,
                           itis_tsn, equilibrium_time.utc, sep = "")
         )

# Join tables
Hauls2Fill <- rbind(no.specimen.dat,
                    Haul.weights.sar.no.length)

# View(Hauls2Fill)

```

# Identify hauls to match with

These are hauls where we have complete observations of sardines.

```{r, identify.hauls.to.match.with}

# First filter data to only include sardine hauls
keys.to.match <- US.specimen.dat.clean |>
  filter(scientific_name == "Sardinops sagax")

# Find the number of hauls where sardine are present (remember to add 
# the Hauls2Fill.clean number to the count).
length(unique(keys.to.match$keys))


identical(keys.to.match$Species_weight, 
          keys.to.match$subsample_weight)
# [1] FALSE

# Check if there are shared keys before proceeding
test.keys <- Hauls2Fill |>
  filter(keys %in% keys.to.match$keys)

dim(test.keys)
# [1]  6 27

# If there are any keys present,
# they have already been taken care of 
# in the redistribution of weight.
identical.keys <- keys.to.match |>
  filter(keys %in% test.keys$keys)

# View(test.keys)
#View(identical.keys)

# Remove the entries already accounted
# for from Hauls2Fill
Hauls2Fill.clean <- Hauls2Fill |>
  filter(!keys %in% identical.keys$keys)

dim(Hauls2Fill.clean)
# [1] 13 27

```

# Treat remaining data based on nearest distance

The objective here is to find the closest corresponding haul in time and space. Your target data frame will have the missing entries you are extrapolating (i.e., the missing observations).

## Define target and source data

```{r, define.target.and.source.data.frames}

#------------------------------------
# Create transect data for data to fill
#------------------------------------
Hauls2Fill.clean_sf <- 
  make_transect_sf(
  Hauls2Fill.clean, crs = 4326) |>
  mutate(DatSource = "2Fill") |>
  distinct() |>
  group_by(keys, DatSource, geometry) |>
  # Create a single group id and assign it to all rows in that group
  mutate(index = cur_group_id()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  st_transform(., crs = aea_custom) |>
  # Remove columns to fill
  select(-c(weight, standard_length, specimen_number,
            subsample_count))

unique(is.na(Hauls2Fill.clean_sf))

#------------------------------------
# For known data (pre-processed data 
# where specimen samples are present)
#------------------------------------

# Create unique grouping key - place holder to join on later
keys.to.match.temp <- keys.to.match |>
  make_transect_sf(crs = 4326) |>
  distinct() |>
  group_by(keys, geometry) |>
  # Create a single group id and assign it to all rows in that group
  mutate(index = cur_group_id()) |>
  ungroup()

identical(keys.to.match.temp$subsample_weight,
          keys.to.match.temp$Species_weight)
# [1] FALSE

# For creation of the distance matrices
knownDat_sf <- keys.to.match.temp |>
  mutate(DatSource = "source") |>
  distinct() |>
  group_by(keys, geometry, DatSource) |>
  # Create a single group id and assign it to all rows in that group
  mutate(index = cur_group_id()) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  st_transform(., crs = aea_custom) |>
  select(index, geometry, equilibrium_time.utc, 
         DatSource) 

unique(is.na(knownDat_sf))

```

## Create a distance matrices

```{r, create.distance.matrices}

#------------------------------------
# For spatial distances
#------------------------------------
# Extract projected coordinates (in meters)
Hauls2Fill.clean_xy <- st_geometry(Hauls2Fill.clean_sf)
knownDat_xy <- st_geometry(knownDat_sf)

## Spatial distance matrix (Euclidean in meters)
dist_matrix <- st_distance(Hauls2Fill.clean_xy, knownDat_xy)
dim(dist_matrix)
# [1] 13 17597

# Remove the units (in metres)
dist_matrix.no.units <- drop_units(dist_matrix)

#------------------------------------
# For temporal distances
#------------------------------------
## Time distance matrix (in mins)
temp_matrix <- compute_time_diff_matrix(
  Hauls2Fill.clean_sf$equilibrium_time.utc,
  knownDat_sf$equilibrium_time.utc,
  units = "secs")

dim(temp_matrix)
# [1] 13  17597

```

## Combine matrixes and weight

```{r, combined.spatial.temporal.distance}

#----------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Combine with Weights (Adjust these to change 
# 'importance')
#----------------------------------------------------------
spatial_weight <- 1  # 1 meter

# Create a temporal weight measure for seconds 
# Note that we need to convert the ship speed (knots)
# to m/s or some other unit of time. To convert 1 knot
# to km/h you would multiple by 1.852. To convert to 
# second, you would use then divide 1.852 by 3600.
# We get the 4.06 knot speed from mean average speed recorded 
# in the survey reports
time_weight <- 4.06*1.852*(1000/3600)

combined_score <- 
  (dist_matrix.no.units * spatial_weight) + 
  (temp_matrix * time_weight)

# Find the index of the minimum score for each target row
nearest_index <- apply(combined_score, 1, which.min)

# Create a row-column indexer for matrix extraction
row_idx <- seq_len(nrow(combined_score))
matrix_indexer <- cbind(row_idx, nearest_index)

#------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Extract Values and Add Metadata
#------------------------------------------------------

# The 'Match Quality' columns
Hauls2Fill.clean_sf$match_combined_score <- 
  combined_score[matrix_indexer]
Hauls2Fill.clean_sf$match_dist_meters <-
  dist_matrix.no.units[matrix_indexer]
Hauls2Fill.clean_sf$match_diff_seconds <- 
  temp_matrix[matrix_indexer]

# Metadata from the matched 'Known' record
Hauls2Fill.clean_sf$nearest_key <- 
  knownDat_sf$index[nearest_index]
Hauls2Fill.clean_sf$nearest_tim <-
  knownDat_sf$equilibrium_time.utc[nearest_index]

# Convert geometry of the match for record keeping
matched_geom <- 
  st_geometry(knownDat_sf)[nearest_index] |> 
  st_transform(4326)

Hauls2Fill.clean_sf$nearest_haul_loc <- 
  as.character(matched_geom)

#---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Final Summary Column (Human Readable)
#---------------------------------------------------------
Hauls2Fill.clean_sf <- Hauls2Fill.clean_sf |>
  mutate(match_summary = 
           paste0("Dist: ", round(match_dist_meters/1000, 2), 
                  "km | Time: ", round(match_diff_seconds/60, 1),
                  "min"))

# Remove geometry if you need a clean dataframe
final_df <- st_drop_geometry(Hauls2Fill.clean_sf)

# View(final_df)

```

## Join lenth comps based on closest values

```{r, assign.closes.lenComps}

# 1. Prepare the Donor Pool (Individual Fish)
# This pulls the actual measured fish records 
# from your source data
donor_pool <- keys.to.match.temp |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(index, 
         standard_length, 
         subsample_count,
         specimen_number,
         weight_donor = weight, 
         sub_wgt_donor = subsample_weight)

# 2. Join and Scale (The "Expansion" Step)
# We take final_df (one row per haul) and join it 
# to donor_pool (many rows per haul)
final_expanded_specimens <- final_df |>
  # Match the 'nearest_key' found by your distance
  # matrix to the donor index
  left_join(donor_pool, by = c("nearest_key" = "index"),
            relationship = "many-to-many") |>
  
  # 3. Apply the proportional scaling
  # We adjust the donor fish weight to fit your target 
  # basket weight
  mutate(
    synthetic_indiv_weight = 
      weight_donor * (subsample_weight / sub_wgt_donor)
    )

# View(final_expanded_specimens)

```

## Save summary of corresponding values

```{r, summary}

Hauls2Fill.clean_sf.f.summary <- final_expanded_specimens |>
  select(keys, cruise, ship, haul, collection, start_latitude,
         start_longitude, stop_latitude, stop_longitude,
         equilibrium_time.utc, index, match_combined_score, 
         match_dist_meters, match_diff_seconds, nearest_key,
         nearest_tim, nearest_haul_loc, match_summary) |>
  distinct() |>
  st_drop_geometry()

# View(Hauls2Fill.clean_sf.f.summary)

fwrite(
  Hauls2Fill.clean_sf.f.summary, 
  here(dir, "Data", survey.path,
       "ATM.Survey.estimated.specimen.weight-lenComps.csv"), 
  sep = ",")

```

# Join all data sets

```{r, final.merge}

# Check for mismatched columns
!colnames(final_expanded_specimens) %in%
  colnames(US.specimen.dat.clean)
#  [1] FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE
# [12] FALSE  TRUE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE
# [23] FALSE  TRUE  TRUE  TRUE  TRUE  TRUE  TRUE  TRUE  TRUE  TRUE FALSE
# [34] FALSE FALSE  TRUE  TRUE  TRUE

# Extract names of missing columns
names(final_expanded_specimens)[c(13,24:32,35:38)]
#  [1] "keys.temp"              "DatSource"             
#  [3] "index"                  "match_combined_score"  
#  [5] "match_dist_meters"      "match_diff_seconds"    
#  [7] "nearest_key"            "nearest_tim"           
#  [9] "nearest_haul_loc"       "match_summary"         
# [11] "specimen_number"        "weight_donor"          
# [13] "sub_wgt_donor"          "synthetic_indiv_weight"

# Drop and rename columns to match US.specimen.dat.clean
## Note here we keep the original subsample_weight,
## the original Species_weight, and the synthetic
## individual weights
final_expanded_specimens.clean <-
  final_expanded_specimens |> 
  select(-c(DatSource, index, match_combined_score, 
            match_dist_meters, match_diff_seconds,
            nearest_key, nearest_tim, nearest_haul_loc,
            match_summary, weight_donor, sub_wgt_donor)) |>
  rename(weight = synthetic_indiv_weight)

# Add keys.temp to US.specimen.dat.clean file
US.specimen.dat.clean <- US.specimen.dat.clean |>
  mutate(keys.temp = paste(cruise, ship, haul, collection,
                           itis_tsn, equilibrium_time.utc, 
                           sep = "")
         )
         
# Check for mismatched columns
!colnames(US.specimen.dat.clean) %in%
  colnames(final_expanded_specimens.clean)
#  [1] FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE
# [12] FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE
# [23] FALSE FALSE FALSE FALSE

# Join back to clean data
allDat <- rbind(final_expanded_specimens.clean, 
                US.specimen.dat.clean)

# Verify that these entries correspond to other species
test.na.length <- allDat |>
  filter(is.na(standard_length) & 
           scientific_name == "Sardinops sagax")

unique(test.na.length)

dim(allDat)
# [1] 21347  27

allDat <- allDat |>
  mutate(date = date(equilibrium_time.utc)) |>
  mutate(Year = year(date),
         Month = month(date))

fwrite(
  allDat,
  here(dir, "Data", survey.path,
       "2003.2024.ATM.Survey.with.integrated.specimen.data.csv"), 
       sep = ",")

```

check.month <- fread(here(dir, "Data", survey.path, "2003.2024.ATM.Survey.with.integrated.specimen.data.csv"), sep = ",")

#  [1] 200307 200403 200404 200407 200503 200504 200604 200704 200706 200804 200807 200904 201004 201104 201204 201207
# [17] 201208 201304 201307 201404 201407 201504 201507 201604 201607 201704 201707 201807 201907 202103 202107 202207
# [33] 202307 202407 202506

#----------------------
# For summer survey
#----------------------

check.month.summer <- check.month |> 
  filter(cruise > 200804 & cruise < 202103) |>
  filter(!cruise %in% c(200904, 201004, 201104, 201204, 201304, 201404, 
                        201504, 201604, 201704))
